title: Clones Attack Dooku’s Forces
front_description: Surrounding the Geonosian arena are massed lines of doked Trade Federation starships and countless droids. Now, they themsehes are surrounded by thousands of Republic starships, which disgorge tens of thousands of battle-ready clone troopers.With a ferocity that takes both machine and alien by surprise, the troops do exactly what they've been bred to do. Beyond, more Republic starships are landing and spewing out reinforcements.
back_description: A digital composition of attacking Clone Troopers and Republic gunships.
